search_text: published ZDI-06-021 ZDI-CAN-034 WebEx Downloader Plug-in Code Execution Vulnerability 2006-07-06 CVE-2006-3423 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2006-3423 ['WebEx Communications Inc.'] ['Web Conference ActiveX Control'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of the WebEx Downloader Plug-in. Successful exploitation requires that the target user browse to a malicious web page. The specific flaws exists due to the lack of input validation on various ActiveX/Java control parameters and configuration directives. The "GpcUrlRoot" and "GpcIniFileName" ActiveX/Java control parameters allow an attacker to specify the location of a configuration file containing further control directives. This allows an attacker to transfer arbitrary files and executables to the target. The attacker can then leverage available configuration directives to execute the newly created executables thereby compromising the underlying system. WebEx Communications Inc. has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://www.webex.com/lp/security/ActiveAdv.html?TrackID=123456 ['2006-04-11 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2006-07-06 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Anonymous https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-06-021/
